mapper.select: SELECT latest_overview.name as name, latest_overview.description as description, latest_price.price as price, latest_stock.quantity as quantity FROM products.product_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_id) * FROM products.overview ORDER BY product_id, created_at DESC ) AS latest_overview ON products.product_id.id = latest_overview.product_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_id) * FROM products.price ORDER BY product_id, created_at DESC ) AS latest_price ON products.product_id.id = latest_price.product_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_id) * FROM products.stock ORDER BY product_id, created_at DESC ) AS latest_stock ON products.product_id.id = latest_stock.product_id WHERE product_id.id = #{id.value}
